Kanopy is a free streaming service that partners with public library systems around the world offering a vast library of free movies to library card holders. Kanopy features free movies with zero ads because it's supported by tax money, not ad revenue. So, in a way, you're already paying for Kanopy... you might as well take full advantage of all the great movies Kanopy has to offer.
